spans.s:
अज्जुका f. (-का) A courtezan, (in theatrical language.)
 E. अज to go,
or here, to gain, and उकन् affix; sometimes read अर्ज्जुका, from
अर्ज to earn, to gain.

आजुर् f. (-जूः) Working without wages.
 E. आङ् before जुर to become
old, क्विप् affix; also आजू.

आजू f. (-जूः) See the preceding.
 E. आङ् before जु to be quick, क्विप् affix
and the final lengthened; or जन to be born, and डू aff.
